title: VoiceOver + Keyboard Nav Gap Map and Token Mapping Notes
content:
Purpose:
This is a working-level review capturing gaps discovered during VoiceOver walkthroughs and keyboard-navigation sweeps of the console mockups and the current component token inventory. The goal is to produce a prioritized backlog for the design-system and engineering teams that improves keyboard/VO reliability and reduces token drift between tokens and runtime values.

Scope and test surfaces:
- Screens: Routes list, Model detail, Rollouts editor, Dedicated capacity billing modal, User settings, Token usage table.
- Components exercised: table-row, dropdown-select, segmented-control, modal-dialog, toast, inline-action, advanced-filter-chip, code-block.
- Tests run: VoiceOver on macOS (Safari + Chrome), Safari NVDA equivalent notes, full keyboard tab order with Shift+Tab, arrow-key subnav, Escape to close modals.

High-level findings (summary):
1) Focus order inconsistencies: several composite components (segmented controls, filter chips) introduce internal focus traps — pressing Tab from table header jumps into visually unrelated controls. Root cause: we rely on nonsemantic wrappers and tabindex=0 on many children.
2) VoiceOver announcements: many interactive icons (inline action buttons and status badges) do not have accessible labels — they are announced as 'button' or not at all. Some decorative icons should be aria-hidden but are currently exposed.
3) Modal handling: the rollout editor modal sometimes leaves focus on body content after open when there is a header breadcrumb present; VO reads page content then the modal, causing user disorientation.
4) Token drift: semantic token names in design tokens file (semantic/button-cta-bg) do not consistently map to runtime token names used in CSS variables (e.g., --rdw-btn-primary-bg-v2). This causes mismatch when teams propose token updates.
5) Color contrast: most tokens pass, but 'muted-label' used in table footers at 12px fails 4.5:1 when displayed on older OS subpixel rendering.

Concrete wireframe notes (per component):
- Segmented control (model/version toggle):
  - Wireframe shows each segment as div with role='tab'. Need explicit role='tablist' wrapper and proper aria-selected toggling.
  - Keyboard: Left/Right arrow should move focus within tabs; Enter should activate. Current prototype only responds to click. Mark as high priority.

- Table rows (Routes list):
  - Inline action menu (kebab) is focusable but does not shift focus to first menu item on open. Add focus trap inside menu and ensure Escape returns focus to kebab.
  - Row expansion uses aria-expanded but summary is not announced because the trigger is not a button element. Convert to <button> or add role='button' + tabindex=0 and key handlers.

- Modal dialog (Rollout editor):
  - On open, focus should go to first interactive field. Current behavior leaves focus on breadcrumb link. Suggest a short delay focus trap to allow any router transitions then focus the title input.
  - Ensure aria-modal='true' and inertness on background content (or aria-hidden on main content region) for screen reader clarity.

- Toasts / Inline alerts:
  - Toasts are currently appended at the end of DOM which can be off-screen for VO. Use aria-live='polite' for non-critical, aria-live='assertive' for errors. Ensure toasts do not steal focus unless user-initiated.

Token mapping gap map (current -> desired):
- semantic/button-cta-bg -> --rdw-btn-primary-bg-v2 (mismatch: v2 suffix used only in dedicated-css; design token points to legacy hex)
- semantic/muted-label -> --rdw-text-muted (runtime) but font-size scalars differ (12px in comps vs 13px in code)
- semantic/interactive-focus-ring -> --rdw-focus-outline (impl currently uses 3px shadow in some components)
Notes: we need a small script to extract computed CSS vars from the deployed Storybook and cross-check against the tokens in the design repo to highlight mismatches (low-effort, high-value).

Contrast and platform quirks:
- Muted label on table footer: measured WCAG ratio 3.9:1 on macOS display (12px, 400 weight). Proposal: bump to 13px or increase weight to 500 to reach 4.5:1.
- Focus ring color uses brand-blue at 40% opacity on dark backgrounds causing an effective contrast < 3. Best practice: use solid 1.5px outline with accessible color or add subtle drop shadow while maintaining visible contrast.

Backlog grooming (prioritized items):
1) High (owner: Jun Park) - Segmented control keyboard behavior and role correction (JIRA-PS-487) - estimate: 2 dev days + 1 design review.
2) High (owner: Diego Alvarez) - Modal focus management + background inerting (JIRA-PS-492) - estimate: 3 dev days.
3) Medium (owner: Maya Patel) - Token sync script + failing token report (CONFLUENCE-1204) - estimate: 2 dev days, 1 infra day to run nightly.
4) Medium (owner: Elliot Chen) - Toasts: aria-live adjustments and documentation for when to steal focus - estimate: 1 dev day.
5) Low (owner: UX backlog) - Contrast fixes for muted-label (design change + content QA) - estimate: UX microtask + release note.

Open questions / discussion points:
- Do we adopt 'inert' polyfill in console for background masking, or prefer aria-hidden toggles? Engineering preference? (noted Slack thread #console-accessibility)
- Should tokens be canonicalized in a single repo with CI guardrails? How disruptive will renaming be for Dedicated CSS patches?
- Are there any existing SRE concerns about adding focus-trap libs to the runtime bundle? (Elliot to check bundle size impact)

Action items (next 2 weeks):
- Jun: prototype ARIA tablist changes in Storybook (focus keyboard demo + tests). Due: 2026-04-14.
- Diego: implement modal focus transfer and add simple aria-hidden toggle for main content. Due: 2026-04-16.
- Maya: write initial token comparison script and export a CSV of mismatches; attach to CONFLUENCE-1204. Due: 2026-04-12.
- Elliot: run Lighthouse + bundle analyzer to confirm no regressions from proposed libs. Due: 2026-04-15.

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is intentionally pragmatic and oriented to get devs unblocked. Please comment inline with code snippet examples for the tab/role fixes you prefer. If you hit contradictory platform behavior (Safari VO vs Chrome VO), add a short note and include the macOS/OS version tested.

References / quick links:
- Slack: #console-accessibility (recent thread on modals)
- Storybook: https://storybook.redwood-inference.internal/console/components
- GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/912 (segmented control prototype)

Status log (quick timeline):
- 2026-04-07: initial walkthrough + VoiceOver pass (Asha)
- 2026-04-08: wireframe updates reviewed with Jun, Diego
- 2026-04-09: first token sync script draft (Maya)
- 2026-04-10: compiled backlog and owners (this doc)

End of notes.
